# oncall_teams (Data Source)

Lists oncall teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oncall_teams" "all" {
  scope = "all"
}

output "team_names" {
  value = [for t in data.oncall_teams.all.teams : t.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scope` (String) "all" (default) lists every team regardless of membership; any other value lists only the token owner's own teams (GET /admin/teams's default).

### Read-Only

- `teams` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Team description.
- `id` (String) Team UUID.
- `name` (String) Team name.
